name: Penpot
description: Design and prototyping for teams, an open-source Figma alternative

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The PostgreSQL database with every design, assets/ with the uploaded images and fonts, and state/secrets.env, this install's own keys made on first start. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Penpot web app, API and mail viewer (/mail), published on host as 6751

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6751. It must be the exact address you open Penpot at; images, exports and sign-in use it. Behind a domain, use that instead, like https://design.example.com.
